goal: Make black-box package-manager gates the baseline.
description: Replace placeholder or optional integration coverage with runnable black-box scenarios for install, resolve, lock, offline, registry, rollback, and workflow failure behavior.

acceptance_criteria.text: CTest and CI run the black-box package-manager scenarios without placeholder scripts.
The scenarios create isolated project roots and SPIO_HOME directories and assert both success and failure payloads.

goal: Align CI and release gates around the same invariants.
description: Make submit, delivery, health, docs, native, and interop gates prove equivalent package-manager invariants so a green PR cannot bypass release-critical checks.

acceptance_criteria.text: CI and release/checkpoint gate documentation reference the same invariant set.
submit-gate, delivery-gate, docs-gate, native checks, and registry/workflow gates are wired or explicitly mapped to equivalent coverage.

goal: Verify advertised release artifacts on fresh machines.
description: Make every advertised spio and styio artifact target installable, checksum-verified, discoverable by doctor, and removable or upgradeable through documented commands.

acceptance_criteria.text: The advertised artifact matrix is tested by fresh temporary install roots.
spio doctor reports platform, release root, checksum, managed styio status, and actionable errors for each advertised target.

goal: Keep docs lifecycle and generated indexes part of delivery quality.
description: Ensure plan, ADR, governance, operations, and team docs stay indexed and lifecycle-checked as part of the package-manager delivery floor.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs-index, docs-lifecycle, docs-audit, and docs-gate pass after plan and owner-document changes.
Documentation references point to functional plan directories and owner documents, not retired loose plan files.
